title: CLSU grad tops November 2026 veterinarians licensure exam
summary: A graduate of Central Luzon State University achieved the highest score in the computer-based licensure examination for veterinarians held earlier this month.

blocks.text: A graduate of Central Luzon State University achieved the highest score in the computer-based licensure examination for veterinarians held earlier this month.

According to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), 1,083 out of 1,503 test takers passed the exam, given by the Board of Veterinary Medicine at test centers in Metro Manila, Baguio, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Koronadal, Legazpi, Lucena, Pampanga, Rosales, Tuguegarao and Puerto Princesa.
CLSU's Michela Nicole Liwanag Rivera was the top scorer with a result of 92.50%, while the top performing schools were:

items: with 100 or more test takers: University of the Philippines-Los Baños, with 115 of 119 passing (96.64% success rate)
with 50 to 99 test takers: Central Mindanao University, with 81 of 90 passing (90.00% success rate)
